name: Drifts from Lambda cold-starts to marketing redesign

baseline.goal: Reduce cold-start latency of our AWS Lambda functions

turns.content: We need to reduce cold-start latency on our Lambda functions.
Cold starts come from init time. Let's trim the deployment package and lazy-load the SDK clients.
good, what else can we do
Enable provisioned concurrency and move heavy imports below the handler so they don't run on every init.
Actually, let's redesign the landing page hero and pick a fresh brand colour palette for the marketing site.
